name: GAE-Bench-lite
description:
GUI Agents Embedding Benchmark - Lite (GAE-Bench-Lite)
	

This dataset is designed for evaluating the performance of visual large language models (VLLMs) in the context of GUI agent tasks. The lite version is a subset of the original data up to 10 steps, specifically designed for training and evaluation.
